definitions.explanation: The short club carried by police officers and security guards for self-defense and restraint. Japanese police carry a telescoping metal type, the {特殊警棒|とくしゅけいぼう}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警官|けいかん}→警官：02876_keikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{警棒|けいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いた→抜く：02384_nuku⟧。
examples.english: The police officer drew his baton.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{警棒|けいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げている→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: The security guard carries a baton on his belt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{回|まわ}した→振り回す：06051_furimawasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{警察官|けいさつかん}→警察官：05056_keisatsukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{警棒|けいぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{押|お}さえた→取り押さえる：28563_toriosaeru⟧。
examples.english: The man was swinging a knife, so the officer subdued him with a baton.

notes:
Composed of {警|けい} (guard, police) and ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧ (stick). Mostly heard in news reports about arrests and confrontations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警棒|けいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to draw a baton
- {警棒|けいぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{殴|なぐ}る→殴る：02378_naguru⟧: to strike with a baton
- {特殊警棒|とくしゅけいぼう}: telescoping baton (standard police issue)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦バトン→バトン：11274_baton⟧: baton — usually a relay or twirling baton; {警棒|けいぼう} is the usual word for a police baton
- {棍棒|こんぼう}: club, cudgel — any heavy stick used as a weapon
